'''Rystáll Sant''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Theelin-human hybrid]] singer and dancer who worked for the [[Max Rebo Band]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], she performed with the band in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]].

==Biography==
[[File:DancingTrio-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rystáll Sant with fellow dancers [[Greeata Jendowanian]] and [[Lyn Me]].]]
A [[Theelin-human hybrid]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> Rystáll Sant was adopted by [[Ortolan]] [[musician]]s on [[Coruscant]]. She had an artistic personality, like many Theelin, and had a graceful dancer's body. She attracted attention from a variety of beings and was gifted a cape by a passing admirer, [[Syrh Rhoams]]. However, she was tricked into [[slavery]] by a [[Unidentified Black Sun lieutenant|lieutenant]] of the [[Black Sun]] criminal organization. Sant was later freed by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], and her Ortolan parents arranged for her to perform as a singer and dancer with the [[Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="CEUE" />

[[File:SantAndFett-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Sant and Boba Fett]]
Rystáll accompanied the band on more elaborate jobs. She had a long career<ref name="Databank" /> that included singing in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly before members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescued]] the captive [[Han Solo]] from Jabba's Palace, Sant and her fellow bandmates performed "[[Jedi Rocks]]" for Jabba's court. Her performance attracted the attention of famed [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

The next day, after Leia was captured trying to rescue [[Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker]] appeared in the palace and tried to bargain with Jabba to free his friends. Sant and the other members of the Max Rebo Band were present at the time. Sant watched as Jabba dropped Luke into the pit, fought the [[rancor]], and killed it. Sant and the other members of the band were impressed that Skywalker had killed the [[Pateesa|rancor]].<ref name="Max Rebo 1">[[Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo 1|''Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo'' 1]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sant was a half-[[human]], half-[[Theelin]] [[Gender|female]] with [[Color|crimson]] [[hair]], yellow [[eye]]s, and white skin with pink spots.<ref name="Episode VI" /> She had several horns emerging from her head,<ref name="Databank" /> and had hooved feet.<ref name="CEUE" />

==Skills and abilities==
A veteran performer, Sant was an accomplished singer and dancer who performed in numerous venues across [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Equipment==
Rystáll Sant wore a chunky dark pink [[Cloak|cape]] with a [[convor]] feather collar over a dark red [[Clothing|dress]] while at the opera,<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> gifted to her by Syrh Rhoams.<ref name="CEUE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mara fans that have painstakingly freeze-framed all the palace footage have found a number of hopeful contenders: the redheaded dancing girl that flirts with Boba Fett, for instance. That's Rystáll.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Insider 66">{{InsiderCite|66|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref>}}
Rystáll Sant first appeared in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which she was added into the dance number in Jabba's Palace. She was portrayed by dancer [[Mercedes Ngoh]].<ref name="Original DB">{{DB|character|rystall|Sant, Rystáll}}</ref>
